pet_notes: Use the approved canonical mascot exactly. Compact full-body hooded comic villain, large expressive silver face with angular long nose and dark arched eyebrows, white eyes and black pupils, closed stern mouth. Deep violet #5A1470 hood attached to cape, charcoal plated suit, silver segmented gloves belt and boots, one circular poison-chartreuse #C9E265 chest clasp. Heavy black comic ink and flat color shading with very sparse contained halftone. Symmetric equipment, two arms two legs, no held props. Keep full body readable at 192x208. No bald exposed head, grins, text, logos, scenery, ground shadows, detached marks or effects. Look direction is led by natural hooded head turn and tilt, nose and pupils together, while torso and boots remain planted; face always remains visible.
style_notes: Golden Age comics ink, clean flat colors, consistent hood folds and armor; image references are canonical identity.
